description: Reachability markers (Reachability.Sometimes in LiteDB/ and LiteDB.Fuzz/). Every literal marker is registered here; fault-point markers are derived from fault-points.json. A marker is declared for a diff when its entry is new or changed, its paths change, or (fault points) its hook is added. check_reachability.py fails a PR whose smoke campaign never hits a declared marker unless its gate is advisory. targets lists fuzz targets (observed or intended) and xUnit tests (path#Method) that reach it; xUnit runs do not record markers yet.

kinds.fault-point: the site of a registered fault hook executed (derived)
kinds.maintenance: close, rebuild, fatal error or checkpoint overlapping other work
kinds.refusal: a documented refusal path rejected a request
kinds.api: a public API member was driven (required for API members added or changed by a diff)
kinds.situation: the situation a fuzz target exists to reach

before-candidate-republish.reason: Rebuild rollback branch reached only when restoring the original pair fails; xUnit fault-combination tests reach it, the smoke campaign does not.

before-source-retraction.reason: Rebuild rollback branch reached only when the original WAL cannot be restored; xUnit fault-combination tests reach it, the smoke campaign does not.

SimulatePosixDelete.reason: Evaluated only when Shared mode caches file handles (Windows); the Linux smoke legs never reach it.

markers.name: maintenance:checkpoint-during-active-readers
markers.reason: A checkpoint proceeds while readers keep it from reclaiming the WAL: open transactions outlived its wait, pinned snapshots or Shared leases are live.

markers.name: maintenance:checkpoint-reclaims-under-live-readers
markers.reason: A checkpoint reclaims obsolete WAL frames while live readers pin older versions.

markers.name: maintenance:close-during-active-transaction
markers.reason: An engine (Direct, or a Shared core) closes while a transaction is still registered in its monitor; detected per transaction in TransactionMonitor.Dispose.

markers.name: maintenance:close-during-foreign-transaction
markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target reaches it yet; reached by the listed xUnit tests, which do not record markers.
markers.reason: An engine closes while a transaction owned by another thread is still registered: close requested during another thread's active operation.

markers.name: maintenance:commit-cut-off-by-stopped-engine
markers.reason: A completing commit failed after the engine had already been stopped by a fatal error or close on another path.

markers.name: maintenance:fatal-during-commit
markers.reason: Commit (or releasing its transaction) threw while completing; the engine is stopped with that error as fatal (Transaction.CommitAndReleaseTransaction).

markers.name: maintenance:invalid-datafile-state-close
markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target reaches it yet; reached by the listed xUnit tests, which do not record markers.
markers.reason: The engine closes because of an INVALID_DATAFILE_STATE error and persists the recovery marker (LiteEngine.Close(Exception)).

markers.name: maintenance:operation-refused-by-close
markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target reaches it yet; reached by the listed xUnit tests, which do not record markers.
markers.reason: An operation queued for transaction admission finds the admission gate disposed by Close or Rebuild and is refused with EngineDisposed.

markers.name: maintenance:rebuild-waits-for-active-transactions
markers.reason: Rebuild requests exclusive access while transactions hold admission, so it waits for active operations (LockService.EnterExclusive, used only by Rebuild).

markers.name: maintenance:shared-dispose-during-active-call
markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target reaches it yet; reached by the listed xUnit tests, which do not record markers.
markers.reason: Shared Dispose finds another thread's admitted call still running and drains it (SharedEngine.WaitForAdmittedCalls).

markers.name: maintenance:shared-dispose-during-pin
markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target reaches it yet; reached by the listed xUnit tests, which do not record markers.
markers.reason: Shared Dispose ends a pin (a holder thread keeping the mutex for a thread iterating a leased reader).

markers.name: maintenance:shared-dispose-during-transaction
markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target or identified test reaches it yet; reachability gap to close with a fuzz dimension.
markers.reason: Shared Dispose closes the connection's core while a legacy explicit transaction is still open.

markers.name: maintenance:shared-dispose-ends-foreign-ownership
markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target reaches it yet; reached by the listed xUnit tests, which do not record markers.
markers.reason: Shared Dispose ends a mutex ownership held by another thread of the connection (an open reader, transaction or running scoped operation).

markers.name: maintenance:shared-dispose-with-leased-reader
markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target reaches it yet; reached by the listed xUnit tests, which do not record markers.
markers.reason: The Shared reader registry is disposed while leased snapshot readers are still in use; their leases outlive the connection.

markers.name: maintenance:shared-dispose-with-mutex-waiters
markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target reaches it yet; reached by the listed xUnit tests, which do not record markers.
markers.reason: Shared Dispose starts while threads of the same connection wait for the writer mutex.

markers.gateReason: No PR smoke target reaches it yet; reached by the listed xUnit tests, which do not record markers.
markers.reason: Damage to the sealed checkpoint redo after data copying began fails the open without changing either source.
